scope: Actual visual inspection of seven unmodified desktop UI screenshots, including three 220px portrait detail panels. Partial generated bust art only; no full-body, animation or 1:1 certification.

functionalEvidence.distinction: The browser run passed asset decoding, DOM viewBox, identity and gameplay-isolation assertions. Those checks did not detect neighboring pixels visible outside the source-cell rectangle.

method: Read the frozen browser report and verify its supplied SHA256.
Open all seven archived portrait screenshots at original resolution.
Reopen the full ME2 cover and ME3 page5 references previously rendered from verified official manuals.
Compare visible source identities, bust features, borders, halos, labels and neighboring cells.
Copy the seven original screenshots byte for byte into a dedicated preclip archive and verify SHA256/dimensions.

findings.title: Atlas neighbors remain visible within every portrait viewport
findings.description: SVG viewBox values match metadata, but the physical SVG viewport is wider than the 512×1024 source region. With the current aspect-ratio mapping and unclipped atlas image, adjacent cells appear in the available margins. Every reviewed roster, detail and battle portrait exposes a neighbor.
findings.workScopeConsequence: Garrus ME3 becomes visible in the Thane ME2 detail, and Thane ME2 becomes visible in the Garrus ME3 detail. DOM identity restrictions alone therefore do not establish visual work isolation.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Clip the rendered atlas explicitly to its exact source rectangle or use an inner SVG viewport with the source aspect ratio and clipping. Preserve the PNG bytes.
findings.requiredRecheck: Repeat and inspect all seven actual UI captures after the rendering fix; recheck asset SHA and contextual exclusions. No portrait art/animation completion should be claimed from these preclip captures.

limitedPositiveObservations: The PNG decodes at the expected 1536×1024 dimensions and its SHA matches the generated source.
Character names, selected-card borders, health labels, bars and buttons remain readable at the reviewed desktop size.
The three intended faces are recognizable in the large details, and visible costume cues broadly correspond to the consulted work-specific references.
Soft contours and colored halos blend into the dark panel without an obvious solid rectangular image background in the inspected screenshots. This does not resolve the neighboring-cell defect.
Generic Shepard and all other roster identities retain initials in the seven reviewed screenshots.
